register.labelZh: JUMP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: jump at 可以幫助你描述自己很樂意接受某個機會、提議或邀請。；jump in 可以表示突然插嘴,或很快加入正在進行的談話。；jump on somebody 和 jump at somebody 可以表示某人還未仔細聆聽,便立即批評另一個人。；jump out at somebody 可以描述非常顯眼的標題、顏色、數字或錯誤。；jump up 可以表示某人因為某件事發生而突然站起來。
register.summaryEn: Jump at helps you talk about a chance, offer or invitation that you are very happy to accept. Jump in helps you describe interrupting or entering a conversation without waiting for long. Jump on somebody and jump at somebody can show that a person criticises someone before listening properly. Jump out at somebody helps you describe a headline, colour, number or mistake that is very easy to notice. Jump up helps you show that somebody stands suddenly because something happens.
